recommendations.description: Run provider-by-product reviews for Tampa General Hospital, AdventHealth Orlando, and Lakeland Regional Medical Center across their identified FL Medicaid acute hospital ABD Non Dual, TANF Standard, and CHIP Standard pockets to confirm prior authorization obtained, reconcile authorizations to paid claims, review acute level-of-care initial and concurrent review KPIs, and validate reimbursement against contractual obligations with targeted contract and site-of-care remediation for outlier pockets.
evidence: FL ABD Non Dual acute hospital spend rose with admissions and paid per admit.
Tampa General Hospital is a concentrated ABD Non Dual outlier provider pocket.
FL TANF Standard acute hospital growth is primarily volume-led.
AdventHealth Orlando and Lakeland Regional Medical Center are named concentration pockets.
All highlighted acute hospital pockets are prior-auth required.

recommendations.description: Conduct a targeted claim-level audit for the Florida IP Med/Surg admissions at Tampa General Hospital and AdventHealth Orlando involving CAR-T, ECMO/tracheostomy-level care, Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Relapse, and SINGLE LIVE INFANT DELIV VAGINALLY to validate prior authorization-to-actual match, DRG coding, itemized billed services, and contractual claim adjudication.
evidence: FL IP Med/Surg rare outliers added +$1.6M from only 3 admissions.
Tampa General Hospital CAR-T admission added +$771K.
AdventHealth Orlando ECMO or tracheostomy-level case added +$857K.
PA required code = Y on both highlighted source cards.
peer_benchmarking: No surveyed payer addresses Florida inpatient DRG catastrophic outlier reimbursement or claim-level adjudication.
